whole_physical_contract.entry: ECX is actual 4-byte owner cell. No incoming EDX or explicit stack word is consumed. Plain RET; no callee argument purge. Original semantic class and formal signature remain unrecovered.
whole_physical_contract.captures: Both push ESI and EDI. Reset ESI=cell/EDI=captured pointee; Release EDI=cell/ESI=captured pointee. Pointee is captured by one initial cell load.
whole_physical_contract.null: Null pointee skips decrement, table reads, callback and clear. Reset EAX=captured cell; Release preserves incoming EAX. TEST flags are exposed; no null owner-cell guard.
whole_physical_contract.decrement: For nonnull pointee compute wrapped pointee+4, push its address, call actual IAT CE2220 KERNEL32.dll!InterlockedDecrement (stdcall RET4). EAX is updated LONG. Only exact zero selects callback; negative or other nonzero still clears cell.
whole_physical_contract.zero_count_dynamic_reads: After decrement returns zero read current [captured pointee] into EDX, then current [EDX] into EAX, set ECX=pointee, CALL EAX. No fabricated table, hidden deletion flag or explicit callback stack argument.
whole_physical_contract.callback_entry: ECX=pointee; EDX=captured table; EAX=actual slot0 target. ESI/EDI carry the form-specific captures; inherited EBX/EBP and saved ESI/EDI must obey the observed callee-saved convention. TEST-zero flags precede callback, not a recovered argument list.
whole_physical_contract.callback_stack: Let S be outer entry ESP. After two saves parent ESP=S-8. SDK enters S-16 with counter address at S-12 and returns to S-8. Raw callback enters S-12 with return word replacing retired SDK argument, then saved entry EDI at +4, saved entry ESI at +8, outer return at +C. Required normal callback net stack cleanup is zero. This does not prove a hidden-input-free callback ABI.
whole_physical_contract.late_clear: After normally returning callback or nonzero decrement, write zero to captured owner cell. Even if callback changes that cell to replacement, it is cleared, without reloading/releasing replacement. No blanket alias repair or added guard.
whole_physical_contract.return: Pop EDI and ESI, RET to S+4. Reset sets EAX=captured cell; Release exposes path-dependent EAX: incoming on null, SDK count on nonzero, callback result on zero. MOV/POP/RET do not normalize flags; callback flags remain after zero path.
whole_physical_contract.fault_unwind: No EBP frame, FS EH registration, RAII, cleanup/cookie or guarded recovery appears in these bodies. A fault or nonreturn before clear prevents clear. Original faults, SEH/EH, callbacks that throw, instruction placement and compiler frame aliases are not closed by the Source interface.
